title: CR-013 Silkline Portrait
description: Source-conditioned art-style transformation: translate the verified CR-001 adult fashion photograph into a contemporary gongbi-inspired meticulous Chinese figure painting on an album-leaf support. Uses art_style_transform + gongbi_painting + album_leaf + newly_created. No TransformationPack (painting ArtMethod has no concept_refs; fragments emit on the non-lexical compiler path). Empty EraPack list—no dynasty authenticity claim and no named historical artist attribution. Symbolic reference roles only; binary reference packaging is out of PromptRecipe scope. Operator must supply the verified CR-001 PNG (SHA-256 0dcf8af6cac15441d5e728f98ac53314442984d3a27a5dd193effa2bac46f41e) as the image input at generation time. See docs/CR_013_SILKLINE_PORTRAIT.md. No gallery image attached.

semantic_spec.request: Transform the referenced adult fashion photograph into a contemporary gongbi-inspired meticulous Chinese figure painting on a prepared album-leaf painting support. Preserve recognizable visual identity of the source adult figure, the distinguishing standing stance and key anatomical proportions, the architectural evening-gown silhouette including original neckline and draped fabric construction, and the hairstyle silhouette, but translate photographic skin, satin reflectance, and continuous tonal modeling into precise controlled fine brush contours, deliberate line hierarchy, patient layered pigment relationships, subtle tonal transitions, carefully articulated folds, and a credible smooth prepared painting surface rather than a photographic overlay. Keep the modern fashion wardrobe modern—do not invent historical Chinese costume or accessories. The result must read as brush-painted fine-line figure painting—not a living photograph with painting-texture overlay, not generic anime or cartoon rendering, not uniform vector line art, not Japanese woodblock or relief-print appearance with keyblock carving, separated printing-block registration, or baren-impression simulation, not loose expressive ink-wash painting, not watercolor or oil-paint substitution, and not a handmade historical court painting or work attributed to a named historical artist or dynasty workshop. Keep album-leaf-conscious composition with readable full-figure fashion hierarchy in a 4:5 field, restrained contemporary presentation, and no logos or invented typography.
